 Veterans Day lunch for student veterans and active service members 
 Event Date 
 Wed, Nov 11, 2026, 11:30am 
 - 2pm 
 Building M - Student and Culinary Arts Center 
 I n celebration of Veterans Day, HFC Veteran Services will hold a lunch for student veterans, reservists, and active duty personnel on Wednesday, November 11, from 11:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. in Room M-117 of the John McDonald Student and Culinary Arts Center (Building M on the main campus).
 If you are a student veteran, reservist, or active duty service member, you are invited! The lunch is free and the menu will consist of:
 Pizza
 Breadsticks
 Cupcakes
 Soda and bottled water
 Student veterans, reservists, and active duty service members will also receive a goodie bag co-sponsored by HFC and the Texas Roadhouse in Taylor. The goodie bags will be available for pick-up from Monday, November 9, through Friday, November 13, from 8:15 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. in the Veterans Services office on the first floor of the Welcome Center (Building WC on the main campus). There are a limited number of goodie bags, so get yours while supplies last!
 A brief history of Veterans Day
 Veterans Day is an American federal holiday that honors the men and women who have served in the United States Armed Forces.
 Veterans Day began on November 11, 1919, which was a year to the day after World War I ended. President Woodrow Wilson declared it Armistice Day to honor the veterans of World War I. The armistice that ended the war hasd taken place at the 11th hour of the 11th day of the 11th month in 1918.
 Congress passed a resolution in 1926 urging state governors to make the holiday an annual observance. Armistice Day became a national holiday in 1938. In 1954, President Dwight D. Eisenhower changed the name of the holiday to Veterans Day, which was then expanded to honor all veterans.
 HFC celebrates Veterans Day
 For nine years, the Michigan Veterans Affairs Agency has named HFC a Gold-Level Veteran-Friendly school and employer. HFC is also the first community college in Michigan to be named a Veteran-Friendly Employer .
 HFC has earned Gold-Level status because HFC Veteran Services is able to provide guidance to all student veterans, reservists, active military personnel, and their families that may need different levels of assistance with available VA resources. To be knowledgeable of community resources, HFC Veterans Services participates with the Veterans at the University of Michigan-Dearborn office for meetings of the Detroit Metropolitan Veteran Community Connect (DMVCC) and meetings of the Motor City VCAT.
 HFC honors our veterans throughout the year. On Veterans Day, we often hold public observances led by the Student Veterans Association (SVA). HFC has a Veterans Center in the McDonald Student Center, which provides a safe place that allows veterans to unwind between classes and connect with other veterans who understand the transition from military life to civilian life.
 “We are proud to welcome all veterans, reservists, active-duty personnel, and their family members to the HFC campus community,” said HFC Veterans Affairs Supervisor Dawn Hestand. “We take our role in providing excellent, flexible education to them very seriously, and we offer a broad array of services to accommodate them in any way we can.”
 Additional resources for vets
 There are additional resources available for veterans, including:
 The Veterans Crisis Line , which is staffed by caring, qualified crisis responders. Many of these responders are veterans. If you are a veteran in crisis, call 800-273-8255 or call 988 and press 1, or text 838255.
 The Dearborn Veterans Center : Call 313-277-1428.
 Dearborn Veterans Treatment Court : Call 313-943-2281 or email veteranscourt@ci.dearborn.mi.us .
 Wayne County Veterans Services: Call 313-224-5045.
 Michigan Veterans Affairs Agency: Call 800-642-4838 (800-MICH-VET).
 Homeless Veterans Assistance: Call 877-424-3838.
 NOTE: HFC provides links to external resources solely as an informational service to our community. We do not endorse or partner with these external organizations. We cannot provide referrals or any services related to these organizations. We encourage you to ask questions and make sure the support services are right for you. 
 For questions or more information about any HFC Veterans Day activities, contact the Office of Veterans Services at 313-845-9688 or veterans@hfcc.edu .
